section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1981
title: PART II SUICIDES IN INDIA Suicides A total of 40,245 suicides were reported in India during 1981 compared with the figures of 41,663 in 1980 registering a decline of 3.4 per cent in 1981 over 1980. The numerical decline registered during 1981 over 1980 was 1418. The number of Suicides in 1981 was more than the figures of 1977, 1978 and 1979 but less than the figures of 1974, 1975, 1976 and 1980. During the period 1974-1981, the trend in suicide cases has been erratic. It is seen from the suicide figures that during the period of 8 years, the highest number of suicides was recorded during 1974 (46008) with a volume of 7.3 per lakh of population. If we see the volume only, the figures generally showed a downward trend except for 1980 but the actual number of suicides expressed a mixed trend as the figures from 1974 to 1977 showed a downward trend but registered an increase in 1978 over 1977 and then came down in 1979. These figures again went up in 1980 in comparison to the figures of 1976, 1977, 1978 and 1979 and came down again in 1981. The detailed statistics are presented in Table-I. TABLE I Incidence and Volume of Suicides in India 1974 to 1981
